name: brand-ai-readiness-audit
description: Audit any public website for the defects that stop AI assistants finding, reading and citing it, and that stop visitors engaging once they arrive. Read-only; emits one evidence-backed, prioritised audit report.

skills.summary: Receives the audit request, performs the single bounded crawl, invokes the analyzer skills over the shared snapshot, de-duplicates and grades their findings, and emits the one final report.
Machine access and machine readability: was the crawler let in, and could it read the page from the server response alone?
Fact extraction and entity clarity: can a machine pull a specific fact off the page and attribute it to the right brand?
Currency, self-consistency and corroboration: are the facts dated, do they agree with each other, and does anything outside the site confirm them?
Visitor experience: can someone landing from a search result or a citation orient, find the next action, and keep moving without dead ends?
